svg.title: Prakhar Dubey — Software Engineer Résumé
svg.desc: Prakhar Dubey — SDE at @RecootyInc. Based in Indore, India. He specializes in AI-driven SaaS, backend systems, micro-frontends, developer tooling, and cloud infrastructure. GitHub: 124 public repositories, 13 stars and 34 followers. npm: 7 packages and 8,670 downloads in the last year.
